title: The Pullman house gains its belt course and hooded dormers
items: A deep moulded belt course now runs under the second-floor windows, round the Prairie Avenue front, its bays and the whole 18th Street side, as the 1890s photographs show it.
Each dormer on the mansard is framed in a carved stone hood with ears, faced in the house's own brownstone instead of a pale trim.
Still to come: the dormers on the front and side pavilions' roofs, and the pediment over the large front dormer.
